_comment: System presets (R5). Edit here, not in code.
sourceAspect: aspect ratio (w/h) of the game box Delta sends inside the stream. Defaults to native w/h
(square pixels). Used to crop and to auto-detect the system. Tune from the debug overlay's 'detected' line.
displayAspect: aspect ratio of the panel / output, e.g. 4:3 for TV systems (pixel-aspect correction).
crop: optional explicit crop [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions of the frame; overrides the centered fit.
native: native resolution, used for scanline count. detect: whether auto-detection may pick this preset.
